JK Accounting Group
EN УКР РУС
Book a consultation

For foreign-owned businesses in the US

Building a business in the US? We handle the American side.

Bookkeeping, taxes, and compliance for foreign-owned businesses, explained calmly, in plain words, and in your language: English, Ukrainian, or Russian.

Book a consultation

English · Українська · Русский·7 years guiding owners·50+ businesses·founder-led

Julia KononovaFounder & Chief Accountant. She'll know your situation.

The system is new. You shouldn't have to decode it alone.

You've already built something real — that's the hard part. But the American side comes with rules nobody warned you about:

  • Entity types you've never heard of — LLC, S‑Corp, C‑Corp — and everyone tells you something different.
  • Deadlines that don't exist back home, with penalties when you miss them.
  • Bookkeeping standards that look nothing like what your accountant did at home.
  • Letters from the IRS you can't be completely sure you understood.
  • Advice in a second language — when the details are exactly what matters.

None of this means you're not ready. It means the system is foreign. Making it familiar is literally our job.

A firm built for owners exactly like you.

Your language, every step

Meetings, documents, and explanations in English, Ukrainian, or Russian — nothing gets lost in translation.

This is our specialty, not a side service

Foreign-owned US businesses are who we serve, every day.

We've navigated this ourselves

A founder-led team that knows both systems — the one you came from and the one you're in now.

Senior people, small firm

You talk to accountants, not account managers.

$1M+
saved for clients in tax

years guiding owners

client satisfaction

Read all 38 reviews on Facebook →

Book a consultation

1 hour · $150 · in your language

What we take off your plate.

Enough to see we know the territory. The specifics, for your business, are what the consultation is for.

Most valuable for foreign owners

Tax planning & advisory

This is where foreign owners lose the most money — rules you can't know exist until someone shows you. We plan ahead through the year, so you keep more of what you earn.

“Why does this matter most?”

Because most US tax savings are decided before the year ends, not at filing time. So planning isn't a one-off: it runs through everything we do for you, all year.

Bookkeeping & accounting

Clean, current books to US standards — closed every month, ready for any decision or filing.

Tax preparation & filing

Federal and state returns for the business and for you as the owner — accurate, on time, explained.

Business setup & compliance

Entity choice, EIN, and the obligations that come with each — set up right from day one.

IRS letters & back filings

Behind on books or holding an IRS notice? We step in, speak to the IRS for you, and bring you back to clear.

The people you'll actually talk to.

Julia Kononova

Founder & Chief Accountant
English · Українська · Русский

Julia built JK Accounting Group around one idea: owners from abroad deserve an accountant who understands both systems — the numbers and the journey. Senior tax and CFO expertise, delivered in your language, with seven years guiding owners building in the US.

Irina Jandieri

Tax Accountant
English · Русский · Українська

Deep tax and multi-entity experience, with a steady hand for complex returns.

Maria Zavarce

Senior Accountant
English · Español

Keeps the books current and the month-end close on schedule, every month.

Liudmyla Kazannik

Bookkeeper
English · Русский · Українська

Careful, consistent bookkeeping that keeps your numbers ready for any decision.

Lilian Gonzalez

Client Success & Bookkeeper
English · Español · Русский

Your first point of contact and a steady hand on the books — currently on track to become an IRS Enrolled Agent (EA).

Book a consultation

You'll talk to an accountant — not a sales rep

Three steps. No obligation.

1

Book your consultation

One hour, online, in your language. $150. Pick a time that suits you.

2

We review your situation together

Your business, books, entities, and tax exposure — calmly and clearly.

3

You get a clear plan

What to do, in what order, and what it costs — whether or not we work together.

Good questions, answered plainly.

How much does the consultation cost?
$150 for a full hour with an accountant (not a sales rep), online. You'll leave with a clear next step.
Can we communicate fully in Ukrainian or Russian?
Yes. Calls, documents, and everyday questions — in English, Ukrainian, or Russian, at full parity. You choose the language.
Do you work with businesses outside Florida?
Yes. We're based in Miami and Fort Lauderdale and work with owners across the US online. Most of our clients never set foot in our office.
What if I haven't registered my company yet?
Even better. That's the best time to talk. Entity choice affects your taxes for years; we'll help you start on the right footing.
What documents do I need for the call?
None are required. Just your story. If you have prior returns, formation documents, or an IRS letter, have them nearby; they help, but they're not a condition.
How soon can we start?
Usually within a few days of the consultation. We'll outline the first steps on the call and tell you exactly what we need to get going.
Do you handle back taxes or catch-up bookkeeping?
Yes. If you're behind on filings or your books need cleaning up, we do catch-up work and deal with the IRS on your behalf, a common starting point for new clients.
Book a consultation

We reply within 1 business day

Let's talk about your business — in your language.

A one-hour consultation with an accountant who works with owners like you every day — $150. No pressure, no sales script.

  • An accountant, not a sales rep, on the call.
  • English, Ukrainian, or Russian. Your choice.
  • A clear plan, whether or not we work together.
Preferred language
